```{r}

f_replace_to_fix <- function (x){
  ifelse(
    str_detect(x, "NA%"),
    str_replace(
      str_replace(x, "NO_rse", "(fix)"),
      "NA%",
      "(fix)"
      ),
    x
    )
}

get_df_params_pop_omega <- function(df_mdls_2_compare, param_type="all"){
  df_params_fitting <- df_mdls_2_compare %>% 
    dplyr::filter(!str_detect(parameter, "_pop") & !str_detect(parameter, "omega_")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(param_type="fit")

  df_params_pop <- df_mdls_2_compare %>% 
    dplyr::filter(str_detect(parameter, "_pop")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(parameter=str_replace(parameter, "_pop", "")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(param_type="pop")
  
  df_params_omega <- df_mdls_2_compare %>% 
    dplyr::filter(str_detect(parameter, "omega_")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(parameter=str_replace(parameter, "omega_", "")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(param_type="omega")
  
  df_params_pop_omega <- bind_rows(
    df_params_pop,
    df_params_omega
  ) %>% arrange(
    parameter, param_type
  ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      parameter, param_type, everything()
    )
  
  df_params_pop_omega %>% 
    dplyr::mutate_all(~replace_na(., "")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate( across(everything(), ~f_replace_to_fix(.x) ) ) %>% 
    get_flx_tbl_monolix() %>% 
    flextable::merge_v(j=c("parameter"))
  
  if (param_type == "all"){
    return(
      bind_rows(
        df_params_fitting,
        df_params_pop_omega
      )
    )
  }else if(param_type == "pop"){
    return(df_params_pop)
  }else if(param_type == "omega"){
    return(df_params_omega)
  }else if(param_type == "pop_omega"){
    return(df_params_pop_omega)
  }else if(param_type == "fit"){
    return(df_params_fitting)
  }else{
    return(NULL)
  }
}
```

## Plots

### Population


```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=6}
dir_mlx_ii <- df_mdls_2_compare$mdl_dir[1]

df_yR <- get_observations(dir_mlx_ii, "yR") %>%
  dplyr::rename("TIME"="time") %>%
  dplyr::rename("obs"="observation") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(obsid="log10CFUR")

df_yV <- get_observations(dir_mlx_ii, "yV") %>%
  dplyr::rename("TIME"="time") %>% 
  dplyr::rename("obs"="observation") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(obsid="log10CFUV") 

df_yU <- get_observations(dir_mlx_ii, "yU") %>%
  dplyr::rename("TIME"="time") %>%
  dplyr::rename("obs"="observation") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(obsid="log10CFUU")

df_obs <- bind_rows(
  list(df_yR, df_yV, df_yU)
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(group="data") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(model=NA) %>% 
  left_join(
    DF_ID_STRAIN_AB_CODE_TIME %>% dplyr::rename("ID"="id"),
    by=c("ID", "TIME")
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    strain=factor(strain, levels = v_strain_levels)
  )


df_obs_Stats <- df_obs %>% group_by(TIME, variable, obsid) %>% 
  nest() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$obs, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>% 
  unnest(Stats) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(model=NA)

```

```{r, results='asis', fig.width = 15, fig.height = 6}
lbl_y <- ""
lbl_x <- "time (days)"
y_lims <- c(0, 10)
x_lims <- c(0, 30)

str_pop_color <- "#4d004b"
for (i in seq(1, length(v_mdl_nicks) ) ){
  str_tmp_model_nick <- v_mdl_nicks[i]
  cat("\n")
  cat("\n")
  cat("#### ", str_tmp_model_nick, "\n")
  
  lbl_subtitle <- sprintf("Model %s Individual Fits", str_tmp_model_nick)
  
  plt <- df_indiv_mdls_2_compare %>% 
    dplyr::filter(model == str_tmp_model_nick) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x=TIME, y=obs, color=model)) +
    geom_line(aes(group=interaction(ID, model)), size=0.5, alpha=0.5) +
    geom_line(
      data=df_pop_mdls_2_compare %>% dplyr::filter(model == str_tmp_model_nick), 
      color=str_pop_color,
      size=1.5
      ) +
    geom_point(
      data=df_obs, 
      aes(shape=strain),
      color="black") +
    geom_line(data=df_obs_Stats, aes(y=q50), color="black") +
    facet_wrap(~obsid) +
    labs(x=lbl_x, y=lbl_y, subtitle = lbl_subtitle) +
    scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color="red", linetype="dotted") +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = x_lims,
      ylim = y_lims
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values=nv_strain_shape) +
    # scale_x_log10() +
    theme_ano +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = "white" )) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'white', face="bold", size = 15)) +
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA) ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(plt)
  
}


```

### Rates

```{r}
lbl_x <- ""
lbl_y <- "(1/day)"
df_indivparams_rates <- get_individual_parameters(path_mdl_selected) %>% 
  dplyr::select(id, contains("_mode")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(id, contains("alpha"), contains("q"), contains("delta"))

df_indivparams_rates_pl <- df_indivparams_rates %>% 
  pivot_longer(-id, names_to = "parameter", values_to = "Rate" ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(parameter=str_replace(parameter, "_mode", "")) 

df_indivparams_rates_pl %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sign = ifelse(Rate<0, "-", "+"))%>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=parameter, y=abs(Rate), color=sign)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.25) +
  labs(x=lbl_x, y=lbl_y, subtitle = lbl_subtitle) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = scales::trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x, n=5),
    labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x) )
  ) +
  theme_ano +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

```
<!-- For this all connected models the biggest growth rate takes place in V (Bladder) then R (Kidney) and finally in U (Urine) -->
